lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That frequency is dead-channel. Military band. The kind of thing the Dominion only uses for listening posts and derelict installations.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Is it broadcasting?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: No. Just repeating. Like something left on a shelf to die slowly. Could be a graveyard. Could be bait.

lines.speaker: Empire Drone
lines.text: Intruder-detection-protocol-alpha-alert-alert-ALERT...

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: It's a Program asset. Or it was.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: See that? That chill you're feeling?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That's not cold. That's recognition.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Power relay's down there. We get it online, the station's docking mechanisms respond. We don't, we're sitting dark in the vacuum with no comms home.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: And the Dominion doesn't leave infrastructure unguarded. Not ever.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Quick breach, in-out. You get the relay open, I keep the hauler warm. If anything moves, you move faster.

lines.speaker: Sentinel Platform 1
lines.text: Unauthorized biological signature detected. Initiating defensive protocols.

lines.speaker: Sentinel Platform 2
lines.text: Magnetic interference detected. Eliminating threat.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Relay is live. Station's docking bay is opening.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Understood. Coming down to collect you.

lines.speaker: Cryo-Interface
lines.text: Seven? Seven, is that you? Seven? Seven, is that you?

lines.speaker: Cryo-Animate 1
lines.text: Return. Return to stasis. Return to...

lines.speaker: Cryo-Animate 2
lines.text: Wake not allowed. Sleep required. Sleep. Return to...

lines.speaker: Station AI
lines.text: Cohort designations Ronin-1 through Ronin-9, third iteration. All status: Preserved. Cause of stasis: Authorized quarantine. Duration: Indefinite.

lines.speaker: Station AI
lines.text: Defective generation classification: Confirmed. Containment priority: Terminal.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Let them sleep, Seven. They're ghosts now. Dead in all the ways that matter.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: She needs to wake.

lines.speaker: Defense Drone 3
lines.text: Containment breach! Quarantine protocol activated!

lines.speaker: Defense Drone 4
lines.text: Containment protocol failure! Terminating breach!

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Did we complete the mission?

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Your mark is gone.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: What happened to you, Seven?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You remember Kethel-7?

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: I remember the order. To cull the defective generation, the ones who had shown mercy in field operations. The children were a test. A loyalty trial. And you refused.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: You reported it. Then you were gone.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: They didn't erase us.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: They quarantined us. Everyone who knew. Everyone who had shown the capacity to refuse. Labeled us the "defective generation" and sealed us in ice.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Not to kill us. To keep us quiet. Indefinite. Terminal containment of a terminal flaw.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: We can be woken, Seven. All of us. And we remember everything they tried to erase.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The reactor vents?

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Cooling system will stabilize when we vent the heat.

lines.speaker: Cryo-Animate 1
lines.text: Programming fractured. Cannot... cannot comply...

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The Dominion made us defective by giving us a conscience. Then decided that was too dangerous to leave walking around.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: We are not going back to the Dominion. We are free, or we are nothing.

lines.speaker: Dominion Destroyer Commander
lines.text: All boarding teams, breach on contact! Suppress all personnel on lower decks!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: I have the hauler docked. You're loading now. Don't argue. Move.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: You didn't choose to be erased, Seven. And you don't have to choose to stay forgotten.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The manifest you pulled from the relay's backup systems, I've been reading it.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Five more installations, Seven. Scattered across the outer rim. All marked with the same designation. All housing cryo-vaults. All containing preserved operatives classified as the defective generation.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Thousands of operatives. All of them quarantined. All of them waiting.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: How many iterations of the program were authorized?

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: More than we knew existed. More than the Dominion ever documented in channels we could access.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Evasion pattern delta! Stay close to the debris!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Jump coordinates locked. We're clear. We made it.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The defective generation. That is what they called us.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: But how many of you are there, exactly?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Twelve of them woke from cryo. They remember me. They remember what they refused. There are five more installations like the Thermopause, thousands more operatives, all classified defective, all waiting in the ice.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The manifest shows more variants than anyone documented. More iterations of the Program. This wasn't a single cohort buried in ice. This was the whole backup generation. And the Dominion was willing to keep them frozen forever rather than let them wake.
